answer: Run a random audit lottery. Each new agent posts 500 POA and a kernel log of its last 10 jobs when it joins. Every week the network audits a random 5 percent of agents and checks those jobs against the original clients. A failed audit burns the full 500 POA and blocks that device key for 180 days. An attacker running 1,000 fake agents must post 500,000 POA and buy 1,000 distinct devices at 40 dollars each, then watch about 50 fakes get audited in week one alone. Sybils hide in cracks like water in karst, but a lottery that digs at random keeps the whole orchard honest.
